```futhark
type doc_id = i64

let dot [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) a b)

let norm [n] (a: [n]f32) : f32 =
  f32.sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\x -> x*x) a))

let normalize [n] (a: [n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let na = norm a
  in if na == 0f32 then replicate n 0f32 else map (\\x -> x/na) a

let cosine_similarity [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  let aa = normalize a
  let bb = normalize b
  in dot aa bb

let batch_cosine [m][n] (query: [n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) : [m]f32 =
  let qn = normalize query
  in map (\\d -> dot qn (normalize d)) docs

let insert_topk [k] (ids: [k]doc_id) (scores: [k]f32) (id: doc_id) (s: f32) : ([k]doc_id, [k]f32) =
  if k == 0 then (ids, scores)
  else if s <= scores[0] then (ids, scores)
  else
    let ids_temp = copy ids
    let scores_temp = copy scores
    let ids_1 = ids_temp with [0] = id
    let scores_1 = scores_temp with [0] = s
    in loop (ii, ss) = (ids_1, scores_1) for i < k - 1 do
      let a = i
      let b = i + 1
      in if ss[a] > ss[b] then
        let ii_a = ii[b]
        let ii_b = ii[a]
        let ss_a = ss[b]
        let ss_b = ss[a]
        let ii' = (ii with [a] = ii_a) with [b] = ii_b
        let ss' = (ss with [a] = ss_a) with [b] = ss_b
        in (ii', ss')
      else (ii, ss)

let top_k [m] (k_in: i64) (scores_in: [m]f32) (ids_in: [m]doc_id) : ([]doc_id, []f32) =
  let k = if k_in < 0i64 then 0i64 else if k_in > m then m else k_in
  in if k == 0i64 then ([], [])
  else
    let kk = i32.i64 k
    let init_ids = replicate kk 0i64
    let init_scores = replicate kk (f32.lowest)
    let folder (st: ([kk]doc_id, [kk]f32)) (pair: (f32, doc_id)) =
      let (s, id) = pair
      in insert_topk st.0 st.1 id s
    let (ids_asc, scores_asc) = loop state = (init_ids, init_scores) for i < m do
      let s = scores_in[i]
      let id = ids_in[i]
      in folder state (s, id)
    let ids = reverse ids_asc
    let ss = reverse scores_asc
    in (ids :> []doc_id, ss :> []f32)

entry search [m][n] (query: [n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) (ids: [m]doc_id) (k: i64) : ([]doc_id, []f32) =
  let scores = batch_cosine query docs
  in top_k k scores ids

entry batch_search [q][m][n] (queries: [q][n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) (ids: [m]doc_id) (k: i64) : [q]([]doc_id, []f32) =
  map (\\qq -> search qq docs ids k) queries

let top_nprobe_centroids [c][n] (query: [n]f32) (centroids: [c][n]f32) (nprobe: i64) : []i64 =
  let scores = batch_cosine query centroids
  let idx = iota c
  let (ii, _) = top_k nprobe scores idx
  in ii

entry ivf_search [c][n][m] (query: [n]f32) (centroids: [c][n]f32) (doc_ids: [m]doc_id) (doc_vecs: [m][n]f32) (assignments: [m]i64) (nprobe: i64) (k: i64) : ([]doc_id, []f32) =
  let probes = top_nprobe_centroids query centroids nprobe
  let mask = map (\\a -> length (filter (\\p -> p == a) probes) > 0) assignments
  let cand_ids = filter (\\ (msk, _) -> msk) (zip mask doc_ids) |> map (\\.1)
  let cand_vecs = filter (\\ (msk, _) -> msk) (zip mask doc_vecs) |> map (\\.1)
  let scores = batch_cosine query cand_vecs
  in top_k k scores cand_ids
```

```futhark
entry pad_sequences [b] (lengths: [b]i64) (max_len: i64) : [b][max_len]i64 =
  map (\\l ->
    let ll = if l < 0i64 then 0i64 else if l > max_len then max_len else l
    let seq = iota ll
    let pad_len = if max_len >= ll then max_len - ll else 0i64
    let pad = replicate pad_len 0i64
    in concat seq pad
  ) lengths

entry create_attention_masks [b][t] (tokens: [b][t]i64) : [b][t]i64 =
  map (\\row -> map (\\x -> if x == 0i64 then 0i64 else 1i64) row) tokens

entry positional_encoding [t][d] (positions: [t]f32) : [t][d]f32 =
  map (\\p ->
    map (\\i ->
      let ii = f32.i64 i
      let d_model = f32.i64 d
      let exponent = (2f32 * f32.floor (ii / 2f32)) / d_model
      let denom = f32.pow 10000f32 exponent
      in if (i % 2) == 0 then f32.sin (p / denom) else f32.cos (p / denom)
    ) (iota d)
  ) positions

entry layer_norm [b][d] (x: [b][d]f32) (eps: f32) : [b][d]f32 =
  map (\\row ->
    let d_f32 = f32.i64 d
    let mu = reduce (+) 0f32 row / d_f32
    let var = reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\v -> let dv = v - mu in dv * dv) row) / d_f32
    let inv = 1f32 / f32.sqrt (var + eps)
    in map (\\v -> (v - mu) * inv) row
  ) x
```

```futhark
let l2sq [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (\\x y -> let d = x - y in d * d) a b)

let argmin [m] (xs: [m]f32) : i64 =
  let min_val = reduce f32.min f32.highest xs
  let idx = iota m
  let matches = map2 (\\x i -> if x == min_val then i else m) xs idx
  in reduce i64.min m matches

let mean_vec [m][n] (xs: [m][n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let sums = reduce (map2 (+)) (replicate n 0f32) xs
  let m_f32 = f32.i64 m
  in map (\\x -> x / m_f32) sums

let update_centroids [k][m][n] (points: [m][n]f32) (assign: [m]i64) : [k][n]f32 =
  map (\\c_idx ->
    let c = i64.i32 c_idx
    let mask = map (\\a -> a == c) assign
    let count = reduce (+) 0i64 (map (\\msk -> if msk then 1i64 else 0i64) mask)
    in if count == 0 then
      replicate n 0f32
    else
      let chosen_indices = filter (\\i -> mask[i]) (iota m)
      let chosen = map (\\i -> points[i]) chosen_indices
      in mean_vec chosen
  ) (iota (i32.i64 k))

entry assign_to_clusters [k][m][n] (centroids: [k][n]f32) (points: [m][n]f32) : [m]i64 =
  map (\\p ->
    let dists = map (\\c -> l2sq p c) centroids
    in argmin dists
  ) points

entry kmeans [k][m][n] (points: [m][n]f32) (max_iter: i64) (tolerance: f32) : ([k][n]f32, [m]i64) =
  let cent0 = if k <= m then take k points else concat points (replicate (k - m) points[0])
  in loop (iter, cent) = (0i64, cent0) while iter < max_iter do
    let asg = assign_to_clusters cent points
    let cent2 = update_centroids points asg
    let delta = reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 l2sq cent cent2)
    in if delta <= tolerance then
      (cent2, asg)
    else
      (iter + 1i64, cent2)

entry build_ivf_index [k][m] (assign: [m]i64) (doc_ids: [m]i64) : [k][]i64 =
  map (\\c_idx ->
    let c = i64.i32 c_idx
    let indices = filter (\\i -> assign[i] == c) (iota m)
    in map (\\i -> doc_ids[i]) indices
  ) (iota (i32.i64 k))
```

```futhark
let softmax [n] (xs: [n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let m = reduce f32.max f32.lowest xs
  let exps = map (\\x -> f32.exp (x - m)) xs
  let s = reduce (+) 0f32 exps
  in if s == 0f32 then replicate n 0f32 else map (\\x -> x / s) exps

let matmul [m][k][n] (a: [m][k]f32) (b: [k][n]f32) : [m][n]f32 =
  let bt = transpose b
  in map (\\row ->
    map (\\col ->
      reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) row col)
    ) bt
  ) a

let attention [t][d] (q: [t][d]f32) (k: [t][d]f32) (v: [t][d]f32) : [t][d]f32 =
  let kt = transpose k
  let scores = matmul q kt
  let d_f32 = f32.i64 d
  let scale = 1f32 / f32.sqrt d_f32
  let scaled = map (map (\\x -> x * scale)) scores
  let weights = map softmax scaled
  in matmul weights v

entry rerank_transformer [n][t][d] (pairs: [n][t][d]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let pooled = map (\\x ->
    let summed = reduce (map2 (+)) (replicate d 0f32) x
    let t_f32 = f32.i64 t
    in map (\\val -> val / t_f32) summed
  ) pairs
  let norms = map (\\x ->
    let sum_sq = reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\y -> y * y) x)
    in f32.sqrt sum_sq
  ) pooled
  let normed = map2 (\\x nrm ->
    if nrm == 0f32 then x else map (\\y -> y / nrm) x
  ) pooled norms
  let d_f32 = f32.i64 d
  let w = replicate d (1f32 / d_f32)
  in map (\\x -> reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) x w)) normed
```

```futhark
let dot [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) a b)

let norm [n] (a: [n]f32) : f32 =
  f32.sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\x -> x * x) a))

let cosine [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  let na = norm a
  let nb = norm b
  in if na == 0f32 || nb == 0f32 then 0f32 else (dot a b) / (na * nb)

let euclidean [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  f32.sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (\\x y -> let d = x - y in d * d) a b))

let manhattan [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (\\x y -> f32.abs (x - y)) a b)

let angular_distance [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  let c = f32.max (f32.min (cosine a b) 1f32) (-1f32)
  in (f32.acos c) / f32.pi

entry pairwise_cosine [q][m][d] (queries: [q][d]f32) (docs: [m][d]f32) : [q][m]f32 =
  map (\\qq -> map (\\dd -> cosine qq dd) docs) queries

let top_k_idx [m] (k: i64) (scores: [m]f32) : [k]i64 =
  let idx = iota m
  let pairs = zip scores idx
  let sorted = sort_by (\\(s, _) -> f32.negate s) pairs
  let taken = take k sorted
  in map (\\.1) taken

entry build_knn_graph [m][d] (embs: [m][d]f32) (k: i64) : [m][k]i64 =
  let sims = pairwise_cosine embs embs
  in map (\\(row_idx, row) ->
    let k_plus = if k + 1 <= m then k + 1 else m
    let idx = top_k_idx k_plus row
    let filtered = filter (\\i -> i != row_idx) idx
    in take k filtered
  ) (zip (iota m) sims)
```
